body:
### What happened

`actions/download-artifact@v8` emits this warning on GitHub-hosted runners while downloading ordinary workflow artifacts:

```text
(node:...) [DEP0005] DeprecationWarning: Buffer() is deprecated due to security and usability issues. Please use the Buffer.alloc(), Buffer.allocUnsafe(), or Buffer.from() methods instead.
```

A current public reproduction is the `Download checksum fragments` step in https://github.com/link-assistant/formal-ai/actions/runs/29465138404.

### Minimal workflow

```yaml
- uses: actions/download-artifact@v8
  with:
    pattern: checksums-*
    path: fragments
    merge-multiple: true
```

### Root cause evidence

The v8 bundle includes `@actions/artifact@6.2.1`, whose extraction dependency chain reaches `unzip-stream@0.3.4` -> `binary@0.3.0` / `buffers@0.1.1`; the bundled JavaScript still calls the deprecated `Buffer()` constructor. GitHub Actions now executes the action on Node 24, which surfaces DEP0005.

### Suggested fix

Upgrade or replace the extraction dependency chain and regenerate `dist/` so it contains no `Buffer()` constructor calls. A regression test can execute a small artifact download with `NODE_OPTIONS=--throw-deprecation` (or scan the generated bundle) to prevent recurrence.

### What happened?

After uploading a simple .json file using [upload-artifact](https://github.com/actions/upload-artifact) Github Action, I'm not able to download it afterwards using [download-artifact](https://github.com/actions/upload-artifact) Github Action.

### What did you expect to happen?

To be able to download the artifact

### How can we reproduce it?

A stripped version of our actual workflow which fails to download the artifact:

```yaml
jobs:          
  get-environment-vars:
    runs-on: nscloud-ubuntu-24.04-amd64-2x2
    steps:
      - name: Checkout branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - uses: actions/upload-artifact@v4
        with:
          name: tsconfig
          path: ${{github.workspace}}/tsconfig.json
          overwrite: true

  build:
    needs: [get-environment-vars]
    runs-on: nscloud-ubuntu-24.04-arm64-2x4
    steps:
      - name: Checkout branch
        uses: actions/checkout@v5

      - uses: actions/download-artifact@v5
        with:
          name: tsconfig
          path: ${{github.workspace}}/tsconfig.json
```

### Anything else we need to know?

For these aforementioned jobs, we are using Namespace runners, more precisely `nscloud-ubuntu-24.04-arm64` in both 2x2 and 2x4 shapes

Log excerpt:

```
Run actions/download-artifact@v5
Downloading single artifact
Preparing to download the following artifacts:

Error: Unable to download artifact(s): Unable to download and extract artifact: Artifact download failed after 5 retries.
```
